title: Electactic Stand Mixer With 12 Speed,5.3 Quart Electric Mixer With Tilt Head, Kitchen Mixer for Daily Use with Egg Whisk,Dough Hook,Flat Beater, RED
reviews: Love it just the right size
I love my little stand mixer, I use it multiple times a week for all kinds of dough and it is holding its own. Definitely recommend if you don't need a commercial mixer.
The doughhook attachment is broken on the top. Rest was in good condition and works good
Love it. So easy to use.
